text: Program Description The curriculum system and knowledge structure of this major reflect the professional basic theory of information science and computer science on the basis of solid mathematics. By information theory, scientific computing, the respect such as operations research knowledge education and establish the basis of mathematical model, the mathematical practice class, professional practice each link of training, trains the student to solve the scientific computing, software development and design, information processing and coding, actual problem ability, cultivate qualified for information processing, work by the department of science and engineering calculation.
